name: Ray-to-Image Projection with Near/Far Plane Handling
definition: Projects 3D rays into 2D image space, computing bounding segments (t_min, t_max, xy_min, xy_max) and validity, while handling near/far clipping and degenerate camera origins.
summary: This method projects 3D rays into 2D image space by computing boundary intersections and explicitly handling near/far clipping planes and degenerate camera origins.
